correctness.rationale: The graph neighborhood formulas and window-transfer bijection are valid for all n>=5. An explicit 256-state binary transfer has 576 transitions; exact Newton identities for 256 coefficients prove the factored degree-64 determinant and hence the infinite trace generating function. Brute force confirms n=5..9. The F3 order-six recurrence is invertible with characteristic polynomial dividing t^30-1; all 729 initial sextuples exhaustively yield six valid universal solutions, giving one three-class partition when 3 divides n. No finite-term extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: Exact determinant factorization and full partition census are not implied by the total-domatic existence results of Zelinka, the minimum-total-dominating-set enumerations of Zhao et al., the balanced-three-colour existence theorem of Minyard–Sepanski, or the cubic threshold theorem of Choi–Kwon–Park. Search queries targeted the same graph, all two-class decompositions, aliases, the degree-64 rational transfer, and initial numerical terms. Historical priority remains conditional on what is covered by the inspected literature; absence of a hit alone is not evidence of absolute uniqueness.
residual_risks: Unindexed or older exact 2-coupon colouring enumerations on generalized Petersen graphs might cover the formula.
The degree-64 transfer factorization is established by self-contained exact-integer computation and has no independent external reimplementation.
The original 2026 source has a different main question; this is a value-motivated new counting direction, not a solution of the source flagship theorem.

value.rationale: Counts all ways of decomposing a canonical, well-studied cubic graph family into simultaneous total dominating classes, not just existence or a minimum parameter. Exact multiplicities, an all-order rational series of degree 64, and the unique three-class rigidity address a natural completeness gap in existing total-domatic research and can support robustness and random-partition studies. This is not an arbitrary small example or a table recomputation.
